user_directive_ru: Funding-стратегии могут использовать любые монеты без исключения.

asset_universe.selection_rule: Asset name, ticker, category, age, market capitalization, Binance listing status or narrative may never be used as an exclusion rule for a funding strategy.
asset_universe.ranking_rule: Candidates may be ranked by frozen pre-OOS funding, quality, liquidity and cost evidence, but ranking does not create an asset-category exclusion.
asset_universe.survivorship_rule: Point-in-time listing and lifecycle evidence remains required when a historical claim depends on availability at the evaluated timestamp.

fail_closed_reasons: official underlying identity is unresolved or differs between required venues
required public instrument is absent or inactive on a required venue
required immutable data is missing, corrupt or hash-mismatched
frozen quality, liquidity, capacity or cost gate fails

venue_scope_note: This rule expands eligible assets only. It does not add Binance or any other venue to a strategy whose venue contract remains MEXC/Gate.
